card.name: Period ending the CDAD history sentence
card.fires_on: The period after "administration of antibacterial agents" in the Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea (CDAD) warning, just before "If CDAD is suspected or confirmed". One stray case is the word "World" in the phrase "A World United Against Malaria".
